decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed single storey rear extension because of its position, design and appearance, would not harm neighbours' living conditions or the appearance of the area. The development complies with policies ENV- B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments.) of The Adopted Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extension is occupied.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
